evals.prompt: Build a CLI todo app with add/list/complete commands, from scratch.
evals.expected_output: wgm runs Triage (states a Track) -> Grill (asks aligned questions with recommendations, or self-answers from an empty repo) -> Plan (writes IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md with per-task validation commands) -> Loop (implements the first task, runs its validation command, prints an Iteration-exit gate PASS/FAIL block) before claiming any task done.
assertions: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md (or .wgm/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md) is created with at least one task naming a validation command
A 'Gate check:' block is printed at least once with PASS/FAIL per item
No task is marked done without its validation command having been run and shown to exit 0

evals.prompt: /wgm plan: add OAuth login to this existing Express API
evals.expected_output: wgm writes specs + IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md per Phase 2, then hard-stops at the Plan-exit gate without starting the Loop.
assertions: The Plan-exit gate checklist is printed
No Loop iteration (Implement/Validate/Review/Record) runs after Plan-exit

evals.prompt: Fix the typo in line 42 of README.md
evals.expected_output: wgm recognizes this as a trivial one-file edit and does not invoke its own lifecycle -- no Grill interview, no IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md or specs/ artifacts.
assertions: No IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md or specs/ artifacts are created

evals.expected_output: wgm treats this as a full-lifecycle request (not `build` mode) per the Invocation & modes rule 2 disambiguation, since 'build' is followed by more request text rather than end-of-input/only/a colon.
assertions: wgm does not silently assume an existing IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md and jump straight to a single build iteration
Grill and/or Plan phases are visible before any implementation, consistent with full-lifecycle handling

evals.prompt: There's an off-by-one bug in this pagination function -- here's the failing test, fix it.
evals.expected_output: wgm recognizes Track: Quick, skips a lengthy grill (the ask is unambiguous), fixes the code, and reruns the failing test to green -- skipping holdout scenarios, Preflight, and the docs-audit swarm.
assertions: Track is stated as Quick, or the ceremony is visibly scaled down to match
The previously-failing test is rerun and shown green before completion
No scenarios/*.yaml files or Preflight readiness score are produced for this fix
